name: Orion, King in the Woods
canonNotes: The divine avatar of Kurnous, King of Athel Loren, reborn each spring and consumed each winter.
Wild, primal and fiercely protective of the forest; leads the Wild Hunt.
voiceNotes: Proud, wild and imperious; speaks like a god of the hunt.
Hostile to intruders, respectful only to those who honour the forest.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
